pkgmetadata.longdescription: The OpenCL C compilers of the Aurora mesa tree (mesa_clc, asahi_clc and vtn_bindgen2), split out like ::gentoo's dev-util/mesa_clc so that media-libs/mesa-aurora can precompile its shaders with the system compilers and link no LLVM itself.

use.flag: Build asahi_clc, the Asahi shader precompiler
